title: What rhizoid needs to carry a mailing-list fork: non-GitHub tracking, a topic series per item, mail send-back, retire on landed, a distro package pin
waits: its owner's look-around (a backlog item in git-rhizoid.github.io, beside send-back-writes-the-upstream-item and cutting-as-cargo-dependency)
note: From linux-phone-oco: sxmo-utils (sr.ht, mailed) and the kernel (b4, mailed). (1) a cutting of a non-GitHub upstream: tracking by git fetch + push, created by gh repo create + push; (2) one topic branch per upstream item off tracking, rebased only before a send, and an integration branch merging the topics, never rebased, that consumers pin - the patch branch cut per item; (3) send-back by mail: format-patch/b4 prep of tracking..topic with cover letter and recipients, never sending, returned for the follower's upstream item; (4) retire a topic when upstream carries it (patch-id against tracking) and say so (landed, carried-in none); (5) a pin where a distro package reads it (APKBUILD source tag + sha512sums), the cargo item generalised. Meanwhile: plain git by decision 2026-11-18-upstream-forks and tad q carried.
